AI reskilling & role evolution

Role-level evidence for workforce planning, talent mobility, succession and AI professional development. Built from public data only: O*NET 31.0, Anthropic Economic Index, the SUCSS class catalog, IPEDS Fall 2023 and Census QWI. Protocol .

Read before use.
  • Observed usage is not displacement. AI-usage figures show where Claude is being used on public O*NET task text. They do not forecast job loss and say nothing about how any University employee works.
  • SUCSS mappings are unreviewed. Each civil-service class is linked to its rank-1 title-lexical O*NET suggestion. Similarity is not a probability. Validate duties before relying on a SUCSS row.
  • Not for individual decisions. No employee data is used. Do not use this for hiring, promotion, discipline, pay, tenure or layoffs (Illinois HB 3773). Competency levels are design targets for a role, not ratings of people.
